ays.notes: Mapped from the published Stable Diffusion 1.5 AYS 10-step noise schedule. Unsupported NFEs are generated by log-linear interpolation in diffusion noise space before a single normalization into OTFlow runtime; this avoids resampling an already-normalized flow-time grid and is not a full re-run of the AYS optimizer.

gits.notes: Mapped from the official GITS example schedule in the diff-sampler repo, converted into an OTFlow progression and deterministically resampled for NFE 10, 12, and 16.

flowts_power_sampling.notes: Mapped directly from FlowTS FMTS.py::fast_sample_infill, which applies t = (step / num_timesteps) ** hucfg_Kscale, together with the released run.sh default hucfg_Kscale = 0.03. Grouped with late_power_3 as a flow-time late-biased baseline, not as a transferred diffusion schedule.

ots.notes: Mapped with a repo-local deterministic implementation of the OTS continuous-VP logSNR objective to produce normalized OTFlow time grids. This is not a vendored full replication of the official DM-NonUniform integration, which targets diffusion noise schedules and DPM-Solver/UniPC timestep APIs.

atss.notes: Deferred intentionally: ATSS optimizes diffusion timesteps using diffusion score/denoising-error structure, so it is not directly suitable as a fixed time-reparameterization transfer for CFM/OTFlow. A fair OTFlow variant would need a separate validation-derived velocity/residual objective and should be reported as ATSS-inspired, not as direct ATSS transfer.
